title: Data Catalog v1beta1 API: Massive Breaking Changes & Rollback
summary: The Data Catalog v1beta1 API has undergone a significant and breaking change, with nearly all methods and schemas related to entries, entry groups, and tag templates being removed. This constitutes a major rollback and effective deprecation of the v1beta1 API surface.
details: The `datacatalog.v1beta1` API has experienced a near-complete removal of its core functionality. All methods under `entries`, `projects.locations.entryGroups`, and `projects.locations.tagTemplates` have been removed, including critical operations like `lookup`, `create`, `delete`, `get`, `list`, `patch`, `setIamPolicy`, `testIamPermissions`, and `rename`. Furthermore, key schemas such as `GoogleCloudDatacatalogV1beta1Entry`, `GoogleCloudDatacatalogV1beta1EntryGroup`, `GoogleCloudDatacatalogV1beta1Tag`, and `GoogleCloudDatacatalogV1beta1TagTemplate` have had most, if not all, of their properties removed. This change effectively deprecates the entire `v1beta1` API surface. Developers currently using `v1beta1` must migrate to a stable API version immediately. This also rolls back the recent addition of `NODE` and `EDGE` entry types, as the `Entry` schema and its `type` field are no longer available in this version.
